sources.citation: Bizri, Fida. 2005. Le Pidgin Madam: un nouveau pidgin arabe. La Linguistique 41(2): 53-66. doi:10.3917/ling.412.0053 (HAL author version hal-00675379).
sources.note: Nothing. The 'Phonologie' section gives a 17-consonant inventory, says Arabic phonology is filtered through Sinhala, vowel length correlation retained ('Le systeme vocalique connait la correlation de longueur'), Sinhala allophonic rules applied; elsewhere notes functionalisation of intonation in syntax. No word 'accent'/'stress' anywhere.
